GET /staff/lookup.summary: Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)
GET /staff/lookup.description:
The picker for every form that names a staff member: the affected staff of an incident report, the assistant of
a procedure, the person who cleaned a bed, the employee a work order is assigned to, a member of staff registering
as a patient (`linked_employee_id`), a theatre team member or a visiting consultant. Active employees only, at most
20, best matches first (a name that starts with `q`). Only what their badge shows: id, number, name, designation and
department, and their council registration as every author stamp prints it (`license_type`, `registration`, e.g.
"PMDC 12345-P"); the staff directory with contact details stays with HR (`GET /hr/employees`).

A form that must name a registered doctor sends `license_type=PMDC`: only the clinical staff registered with the
PMDC, their number on file, e.g. the doctor present when contrast is given (`contrast_doctor_id` of
`POST /imaging/orders/{order_id}/status`) or the second doctor of an emergency consent (`second_doctor_id`).
`PNC` lists the registered nurses. Every id here is an `employee_id`, never a `user_id`. `VALIDATION_ERROR`: `q`
shorter than 2 characters, or a `license_type` other than PMDC or PNC.
